claims.claim: Cormorants alone took 7.7 % of Oneida Lake's adult perch a year (Rudstam et al. 2004; abstract only)
claims.note: Full text not obtained. The abstract (not a confirmation) gives 'Mean mortality rates of adult percids attributed to cormorant predation were 1.1% per year for walleye and 7.7% per year for yellow perch', with the cormorant diet studied 1995-2000 (walleye and perch 40-82 % of the diet by number) and nesting pairs rising from first nesting in 1984 to over 360 by 2000. The paper's '(abstract only)' label is accurate.
